scope: Exact authoring successors for 32 G4 profiles, four seasonal matrices per profile, 142 conditional natural alternatives and their gated presentation phrases.

provenance.historical_scope: Regional medieval archaeological compatibility; no exact G4 occurrence evidence.
provenance.ecological_scope: Modern or general habitat and seasonal analogy, marked low-confidence inferred or analogical in every alternative.
provenance.spatial_scope: Exact G4 baseline and template context delimit applicability; they do not prove local taxon presence.

review_result: Every applicable baseline layer is represented in all four seasons. Willow is excluded at driftwood_bar and shifting_shoal_field; decomposer fungi require organic substrate and never imply a fruiting body. Fauna remains conditional habitat compatibility, with player phrases limited to separately committed static traces or ambient sounds and exact current-source plus perception or acoustic admission. The text does not identify a present animal or create harvestable stock.
limits: Approval does not establish current local species, animal, trace, sound, visibility, stock, yield or access.
Seasonal selection needs current world date, phenology, water, weather and physical source state; a season row alone does not admit a phrase.
The current 13-layer natural and presentation runtime cannot import the conditional fauna layer without existing-owner contract, loader, validator and projection work.
Mapped import, runtime activation, first-screen readiness and M2c final acceptance remain separate gates.
